thread:
Leah Morgan: Quick ops thread for tomorrow's webinar (10:00am PT). Need owners for: Typeform -> HubSpot mapping, confirmation copy, Zoom recording + captions, S3 upload, and post-event clip pipeline.
Victor Han: I can take Zoom co-host + cloud recording + upload. I'll leave raw VTT and transcript JSON.
Jasmine Patel: I'll draft the confirmation and the 24h/72h follow-ups. Will include calendar add, caption ETA, and distribution consent.
Caleb Wood: Content ops  will make 2 highlight clips and a 30s social cut. Need sentence-level timestamps (JSON) and raw VTT. ETA 2 hours after upload.
Leah Morgan: Typeform -> HubSpot fields: email -> email, full_name -> firstname+lastname, company -> company, role -> job_title, consent -> marketing_opt_in. Add hidden utm_campaign=webinar_fall_2026. Tag leads with "webinar_fall_interest".
Victor Han: Upload path I'll use: s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-fall/${EVENT_SLUG}/. Upload snippet:
```
aws s3 cp /tmp/zoom/recording.mp4 s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-fall/${EVENT_SLUG}/recording.mp4 --acl private
aws s3 cp /tmp/zoom/transcript.json s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-fall/${EVENT_SLUG}/transcript.json
aws s3 cp /tmp/zoom/transcript.vtt s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-fall/${EVENT_SLUG}/transcript.vtt
```
Jasmine Patel: Confirmation copy should say: "Recording will be emailed within 24 hours. Captions available within 48 hours. By registering you consent to on-demand sharing and short clips." Drafting now.
Caleb Wood: Please leave raw VTT + JSON. Also include cloud_recording_id in metadata so I can match files. SRT helpful too.
Leah Morgan: Ops preflight: enable cloud recording, auto-transcript, "optimize for 3rd-party editor", co-host set to Victor, chat auto-save ON. ops-bot  ping #eng-oncall 15m before.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-10-05T16:45:00Z  Run preflight: mic check, co-host permissions, cloud recording ON, captions ON. Will ping #marketing and #eng-oncall if failures.
Victor Han: I'll post S3 path + CloudFront short URL here when upload completes and tag @Caleb @Jasmine. If cloud recording doesn't appear within 30m, I'll escalate.
Jasmine Patel: Post-event cadence: 24h send recording to registrants; 72h nudge to non-viewers. Create HubSpot lists: attendees, registrants-only, viewers. I'll wire the workflows.
Caleb Wood: After upload I'll start clipping as soon as transcript JSON is available. Will upload clips to social-drive and paste links here.
Leah Morgan: Legal-approved snippet is in /legal/snippets/webinar_terms_2026.txt  use that wording.
Victor Han: Ready to run. Will update after dry-run and again post-upload.
Leah Morgan: Thanks everyone  keep updates in this thread. :rocket:
